sources.title: RedHatAI/SmolLM-1.7B-Instruct-quantized.w8a16 · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: This model was obtained by quantizing the weights of SmolLM-1.7B-Instruct to INT8 data type. This optimization reduces the number of bits per parameter from 16 to 8, reducing the disk size and GPU memory requirements by approximately 50%.

sources.title: SmolLM-1.7B-Instruct-Quantized (W4A16): Lightweight INT4 Open-Source ...
sources.snippet: SmolLM-1.7B-Instruct-quantized.w4a16 is a 1.7B parameter instruction-tuned language model compressed to INT4 weights, reducing memory footprint by ~75% while maintaining near-baseline accuracy. Developed by Neural Magic, it is designed for English conversational tasks and is permissively licensed under Apache-2.0.
